items.headline: Coastal Flood Statement issued October 9 at 7:15PM EDT until October 10 at 12:00PM EDT by NWS Miami FL
items.description:
* WHAT...Isolated minor coastal flooding.

* WHERE...Mainland Monroe, Coastal Broward County, Coastal Miami
Dade County and Far South Miami-Dade County.

* WHEN...Through Saturday morning.

* IMPACTS...Some water on low lying roads and property.
items.instruction: Do not drive through flooded roadways.
